title: Geometry and topology of the tempered Iwahori-spherical representations of a split semisimple $p$-adic group
summary: Let $\mathfrak{G}$ be a connected split $p$-adic group of type $B_n$, $C_n$ or $D_n$. Amongst the tempered representations of $\mathfrak{G}$ a key role is played by the Iwahori-spherical block. We provide a compact Hausdorff model for this space which allows us to compute the $K$-theory ranks for the corresponding $C^*$-algebra. The model, an extended quotient, is stratified by sectors. Underlying the approach of this paper is the interplay between the geometric extended quotient and the spectral extended quotient in the context of the ABPS conjecture.
